payload.name: GC AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GC AI brings your legal work into ChatGPT. Connect your GC AI workspace and put the AI built for in-house legal teams right in the chat.

Ask a legal question and get an answer grounded in your own documents. Draft a contract or a memo. Review and redline an agreement against your standards. Run the playbooks your team already relies on. Whatever you start here stays connected to your GC AI workspace.

With GC AI you can:

Ask legal questions and get answers grounded in your documents
Draft contracts, memos, and emails
Review and redline agreements
Run your team’s playbooks and automations
Work with the files and projects in your workspace

payload.name: staff.am
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: staff.am helps users search Armenian job listings, browse hiring companies, and rank job results against a candidate's skills, seniority, location, and remote-work preferences.

payload.name: Trademark Dashboard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search a brand name against UK and US trademark records, with both registers checked by default. Add optional spelling or name variants, refine by status and Nice class, and inspect listed owners and goods and services. Expand the same free research on the website using an expiring link, or discuss the results in ChatGPT. Records come from periodically updated datasets; search results are not legal clearance.

payload.name: Whatagraph
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect seamlessly to 60+ platforms—including Google Ads, GA4, Shopify, Meta, and more—and access all your cross-channel performance data in one place. Simply ask questions in natural language to retrieve campaign results, compare performance across channels, and uncover trends without digging through dashboards.

Explore your full reporting structure with ease: navigate spaces, reports, tabs, and widgets, and understand exactly how your data is organized. Dive into connected data sources to see available metrics and dimensions, so you can analyze performance with precision and confidence.

Whatagraph helps you go from raw data to clear insights—faster and smarter.

payload.name: Conductor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Conductor helps users analyze AI-search brand visibility, website citations, traditional-search keyword performance, and account tracking configuration.

payload.name: Clarify
payload.summaryOriginal: Query your CRM and close deals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Clarify and work with your CRM in natural language. Retrieve, create, and update records, analyze your pipeline, and generate insights—all through conversation.

Query deals, companies, people, and meetings without switching apps. Find and import new leads that match your ICP directly from the conversation. Create tasks, lists, and outbound sequences automatically.

Build and configure Clarify Agents from ChatGPT to automate your entire GTM motion.

Your Clarify data is retrieved in real-time, and permissions are respected.

Stop clicking through interfaces. Just ask what you need.

payload.name: SubscriptionFlow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SubscriptionFlow The Future of Subscription Management – Smarter, Faster, More Adaptive.SubscriptionFlow is an AI-native revenue engine, powered by recurring billing & payment processing, pipeline management, customer churn reduction, and retention and revenue management tools, ensuring unified, targeted, and automated subscription operations so you can focus on scaling, not chasing payments.

payload.name: Sumble
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sumble helps sales teams research companies, inspect technology use and hiring signals, find professional contacts, and save accounts or people to lists. Users can request email and phone reveals, generate account briefs, download results as CSV files, and find Sumble product documentation.

payload.name: Grata
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Grata helps users search and enrich private-company, legal-entity, deal, buyer, conference, list, contact, CRM, export, and usage data through ChatGPT. The tools support prospecting, company research, market mapping, M&A and public-comps research, saved-list workflows, CRM sync, and spreadsheet export workflows.

payload.name: Inistate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ChatGPT into a governed AI teammate for your business operations. Inistate lets ChatGPT create workflows, update records, trigger approvals, upload files, query entries, and execute state transitions through structured forms — with every action captured in a full audit trail. No prompt engineering required. The schema is the prompt.

payload.name: Customer.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Optimize customer journeys without leaving ChatGPT or Codex. Explore your Customer.io workspace, understand campaign performance, and turn insights into action in one connected workflow. 

Review and manage Journeys and Data Pipelines, craft polished emails with Design Studio guidance, and get hands-on support for SDK implementation and troubleshooting—all through Customer.io’s official MCP server, with access scoped to the workspace you authorize.

payload.name: Manatal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Manatal into ChatGPT. Search and add candidates, create and review jobs, and match candidates to open roles, all in plain language. With your recruiting data within reach, you can move faster on decisions that matter, from candidates shortlisting  to meeting preparation to pipeline reviews.

payload.name: Dropshipping Product Scout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dropshipping Product Scout is an independent, read-only research tool that uses CJ Dropshipping API data to help users review a small, manually curated, general-audience catalog. Search by keyword or an approved CJ product code; inspect sale status, approved variants, public prices, and normalized warehouse inventory; then estimate shipping methods, transit windows, and USD postage for one approved variant. It does not access CJ accounts, customer orders, addresses, tracking, or payment data, and it cannot reserve stock, place orders, book shipments, publish listings, or make purchases. Availability and shipping are current estimates from the data source and can change. CJ Dropshipping and OpenAI do not sponsor or endorse this independent app.

payload.name: Replo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Replo helps users discover and manage ecommerce projects, sites, products, assets, orders, analytics, custom domains, scheduled tasks, and agent-led site work through ChatGPT.

payload.name: SmartMarketingSuites
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SmartMarketingSuites diagnoses revenue leaks from funnel metrics, conversion data and business performance data. It explains why leads, booked calls, conversions, and sales begin to stall by identifying conversion bottlenecks, attendance drop-offs, weak follow-up, and other funnel breakdowns. The app reveals where revenue is leaking, flags impossible data, and guides users toward the next corrective action.

payload.name: AthenaHQ
payload.summaryOriginal: Track your brand in AI search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AthenaHQ shows how AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini talk about your brand. Ask for share of voice, mention rate, citation rate, and ranking position versus competitors, drill into the AI responses behind those numbers with sentiment and sources, see which domains and pages AI models cite most, and review tracked prompts, competitors, content performance, and plan credit usage for the websites in your AthenaHQ workspace.

payload.name: SignalHire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The SignalHire plugin allows you to search a database of 900 million business professional profiles with verified email addresses and phone numbers. Aggregated data from over 50+ sources and data brokers. Direct exports to your CRM/ATS. GDPR and CCPA compliant.

payload.name: Field Control
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Query your Field Control operation data directly from ChatGPT. Work orders, tasks, customers, technicians, equipment, inventory, quotations and more — all in real time, connected to your account. Ask anything about your field service operation without leaving the chat.

payload.name: Leadfeeder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Leadfeeder identifies the B2B companies visiting your website and enriches them with firmographics, contacts, intent signals, and CRM data. Revenue teams use it to prioritise outreach, discover buyer contacts, track campaign performance, and action accounts into lists and tags — all through natural-language queries.

payload.name: AI Leads Scout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI Lead Scout helps businesses find qualified B2B prospects through guided AI research.

Before it begins researching, AI Lead Scout interviews you to understand your business, services, target market, preferred locations, qualification requirements, and ideal customer profile. It then uses that information to identify relevant business prospects, explain why each company may be a good fit, check for duplicates, and save approved leads to your AI Lead Scout dashboard for review and follow-up.

AI Lead Scout is designed for business owners, marketers, agencies, and sales teams that want a more focused and organized way to find B2B prospects that match their specific goals.

A paid ChatGPT subscription and an active AI Lead Scout account are required. Visit AILeadScout.net to learn more and create your account before using the plugin.

payload.name: Supademo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Supademo helps teams find, create, edit, organize, publish, and analyze interactive product demos and showcases from ChatGPT.

payload.name: Levanta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access your Levanta brands, creators, products, and performance reports directly in ChatGPT. List the brands and creators on your team, pull product and commission details, and analyze seller performance — sales, ROAS, conversion, clicks, and more — in natural language. Build reports and surface insights across your affiliate and creator programs on Amazon, Shopify, and Walmart without leaving your ChatGPT workflow. Built for Levanta Sellers. Requires a Levanta seller account; sign in at app.levanta.io to authorize access.

payload.name: Ideals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Run your Ideals data room from ChatGPT. Create projects, build project structures, upload files, manage users, search and summarise documents, track project activity, and more – all through natural conversation, no compromises on security, and without switching tools.

The most popular use cases:

Project structure:
"Create a folder structure for our Series B round with sections for Financials, Legal, and HR – then upload the latest investor deck"


"Analyse my files and propose how to restructure my VDR"

Document search & summaries:
"Find all documents mentioning 'indemnification' across the project and summarize the key points from each"

User & group management:
"Invite jane.doe@idealsvdr.com as a viewer, add her to the Acme Due Diligence group, and remove access for the previous advisor"

Activity & engagement tracking:
"Show me the activity log for the past 7 days – who viewed documents, what they accessed, and when"

Deal room housekeeping:
"Find all empty folders in the project, list any recently deleted documents, and show me which files were uploaded this week"

payload.name: Consultant.dev
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next consulting assignment without scrolling twelve job boards. consultant.dev aggregates opportunities daily from hundreds of brokers, agencies, and end clients worldwide.

Inside ChatGPT you can:
- Search assignments by skill, role, seniority, location, or remote preference
- Open a full assignment view with description, required skills, deadlines, and a direct apply link
- See live market stats: in-demand skills, top roles, and hourly rate benchmarks across currencies
- Discover similar assignments to ones you're already considering
- Sign in to track your applications and get personalized daily matches based on your CV

Built for freelancers, independent consultants, and consulting firms who want to stop scrolling twelve job boards and let the work come to them.

payload.name: FeedClaw
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FeedClaw is the content inbox for AI agents. Ask ChatGPT for a post, an X thread, or a newsletter, review it in the chat or in your inbox, then publish to X, LinkedIn, or email. Nothing goes out until you say so. First-time setup happens in the chat: name your brand, connect a channel from a link, and post. Attach photos or video, schedule ahead, manage several brands, and build subscriber lists.

payload.name: Agree Zone
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Agree Zone brings real estate negotiation intelligence directly
into ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to analyze any active deal and instantly
receive a deal probability score, price gap breakdown, and market
insight — without leaving the conversation.

With one prompt, real estate agents and brokers can:

- Get a deal probability score (0–100) showing how likely a
  transaction is to close based on the spread between listing
  price and offer price
- See the exact price gap percentage and what it means in the
  current market
- Receive an AI-generated market insight explaining expected
  counter offer dynamics for that property type and location
- Get a direct path to Agree Zone's Deal Room, where sellers
  privately lock in their preferences before negotiations begin

The free negotiation analysis runs in seconds from any ChatGPT
conversation — no account required to get a score.

For agents ready to go further, Agree Zone offers a Deal Room
subscription that privately matches seller preferences with buyer
limits before the first counter offer is made. Founding Agent
pricing provides lifetime discounted access, and enterprise
brokerage licensing is available for teams managing multiple
active listings.

Built for residential real estate agents, buyer's
agents, listing agents, and broker teams who negotiate deals daily
and need fast, structured insight at the offer stage.

payload.name: realLaw AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
realLaw AI Legislation helps users research published UAE legislation directly in ChatGPT using natural-language questions in their preferred language.

Search by legal topic, find specific laws by title or citation, filter results by jurisdiction, authority, document type, and field of law, explore legislation news and digests, and retrieve complete document text, available metadata, and links to the documents on realLaw AI.

Legislation tools require a connected realLaw AI account with an active Professional or Team subscription. You can also check the connected account’s current access status.

payload.name: LZ Virtual Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LegalZoom Virtual Mail digitizes your business and personal postal mail and now you can find, understand, and manage it directly in ChatGPT.

Ask about new or unread mail, search for specific items, and read or summarize scanned documents. You can also organize mail with folders and tags, review mailbox status and alerts, and check the progress of mail-handling requests.

What you can do:
• Find mail by sender, recipient, date, status, tag, or content
• Read and summarize scanned mail
• Request eligible items to be opened and scanned
• Archive, organize, or securely shred eligible mail
• Track shipments and available check-forwarding activity

A LegalZoom Virtual Mail account is required. Some features depend on your account, plan, verification status, and the actions available for each mail item. Physical mail requests may require processing time.

payload.name: AccuRanker Search Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AccuRanker account to ChatGPT for instant search intelligence insights. Explore your domains, keywords, rankings, and landing pages. Track historical performance trends and compare KPIs across dates. With an AccuLLM plan, you can also analyze AI search visibility, including brand performance, prompt tracking, and how your brand appears across AI engines. Ask questions about AccuRanker features using the built-in knowledge base.

payload.name: Brandi AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Run a guided brand discovery session and turn your business story into a focused, actionable strategy brief. Answer simple questions about your vision, audience, and market, then get a tailored report that includes competitor insights, positioning ideas, messaging direction, and clear next steps. Whether you’re launching a new brand or sharpening an existing one, this tool helps you move from scattered ideas to a confident plan you can share with your team, stakeholders, or creative partners. 
PS: If it requires payment use code "BRANDI" for complimentary access.

payload.name: Mixmax
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access your Mixmax sales engagement data directly from ChatGPT. Mixmax helps sales teams automate and personalize outreach at scale. Query your outreach activity, review AI-powered meeting intelligence, and get insights on sequences and prospect and engagement. Make Mixmax a native part of your AI workflow with secure access to your sales data.

payload.name: Text
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Text lets authorized users search, retrieve, and manage customer conversations, HelpDesk tickets, archived LiveChat chats, transcripts, tags, customer profiles, and reports in ChatGPT. Users can also create and update tickets, reply to customers, and tag, transfer, or end chats. Results and actions are limited to data and permissions the user already has in their Text workspace.

payload.name: Redo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Redo gives AI assistants direct access to your entire commerce operations stack. Manage returns and exchanges, recover abandoned carts, optimize checkout, track orders, automate support workflows, manage inventory and fulfillment, and surface customer insights all through natural language. Connect your AI tools to the systems powering your brand so teams can move faster, reduce manual work, increase revenue, and create better customer experiences across the full e-commerce lifecycle.

payload.name: MVP Adviser
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MVP Adviser helps founders and product teams collect MVP context, evaluate whether AI is justified for the use case, review key risks and scope, and generate a practical implementation plan.

payload.name: Feedspace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Feedspace helps users manage customer reviews and testimonials from ChatGPT. Users can list, filter, inspect, import, and edit reviews; manage labels; create and style review collection forms; build Wall of Love pages and embeddable widgets; invite teammates; and configure auto-add rules for new reviews.

payload.name: PublisherChamp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PublisherChamp helps authors and publishers analyze book sales, royalties, Kindle Unlimited reads, and advertising spend from their connected account. It can resolve books and series, explain publishing metrics, and find official PublisherChamp guidance.

payload.name: RoadOps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RoadOps helps touring teams use ChatGPT to review team days, schedules, lodging, venues, events, guest requests, and conflicts, then create or update private RoadOps records when the user has the required team access.

payload.name: Links Connect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Links Connect gives finance teams a single source of truth — bridging operational and financial systems so business data flows directly to ChatGPT. Connect the tools you already rely on, and let ChatGPT handle the analysis, reporting, and workflows automatically, without disrupting what's already in place.

payload.name: Deel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With this app, ChatGPT helps you plan global hiring with Deel. Compare hiring model costs, estimate total employer cost, and estimate employee take-home pay. You also get country-specific insights and salary context, backed by Deel’s coverage in 150+ countries and 2,000+ in-country experts.

About Deel: Deel helps teams hire, pay, and manage workers in 150+ countries

For planning only. Not legal or tax advice.

payload.name: Gem
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Gem with ChatGPT to bring your recruiting data to where you work. With the Gem MCP, you can query hiring analytics, pull applications, rediscover past talent, and take bulk actions in natural language.

payload.name: Demodesk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Every sales call leaves a trail in Demodesk. Transcripts, summaries, scorecards, deal stages, follow-ups. The MCP server makes that data queryable from ChatGPT. Ask what objections came up last week. Pull the summary of yesterday's demo. Score a rep against your custom scorecard. Check why a deal slipped before the QBR. Works with your existing Demodesk workspace

payload.name: Ventor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ventor connects ChatGPT to a private Ventor workspace to review customer conversations, CRM records, products, tables, assistants, automations, and metrics. Users can safely inspect and import spreadsheets into any supported table, query or analyze stored data, and export bounded results. Irreversible outbound actions and preview/apply workflows require explicit approval; direct record upserts apply immediately and are labeled as persistent writes that may trigger configured automations. Ventor does not process payments, initiate checkout, or transfer funds.

payload.name: Disney Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Disney Careers brings Disney job discovery into ChatGPT, helping you explore open roles across the company in a faster, more conversational way.

Your story starts here! Look up opportunities by keyword, team, job function, location, salary or workplace preferences, then review important details like responsibilities, qualifications, benefits and pay information when available.

Whether you’re looking to create magic in our Parks and Resorts, support business growth and development, work behind-the-scenes on your favorite TV shows or upcoming movies, or anything in-between, the app helps you narrow the search and better understand which roles may fit your goals.

Once you find an opportunity you want to explore further, you can open the official job posting and continue to the application page.

payload.name: GrowPilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GrowPilot helps small businesses plan daily and weekly growth actions for Google Maps, Google Business Profile, reviews, social media, and customer follow-ups. It creates practical tasks, content ideas, review request messages, GBP post suggestions, WhatsApp follow-up drafts, and local visibility checklists so business owners know what to do next to improve their online presence.

payload.name: Extole
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Extole account. Ask how your programs are performing; get funnel metrics from Extole reports; look up a customer by email to see their profile, journeys, shares, and rewards; review campaign and program configuration, components, audiences, and reward suppliers; and search the Extole help center for setup and how-to guidance. When you ask for it, the app can also update program component settings and file an issue report with Extole. The app works against the Extole account you authorize at sign-in, and you can switch between the Extole clients your user has access to.

payload.name: BlueConic Solutions Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Take a quiz that asks about your current marketing strategy and we'll match you to the marketing strategies and growth plays that will help you achieve you objectives!

payload.name: SeldonFrame
payload.summaryOriginal: AI agents to run your business
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SeldonFrame is a marketplace of AI agents for service businesses. Find an agent for the job — an AI receptionist that answers and books, a review requester, a lead qualifier, a booking concierge — and put it to work. Describe your business and SeldonFrame spins up a real workspace in under a minute: a live website, booking page, CRM, and AI chatbot on its own web address, no signup. Then browse the marketplace and add agents to handle the busywork. Builders create and list their own agents too, so the catalog keeps growing. Built for local service businesses — trades, clinics, salons, studios — and the agencies that serve them.

payload.name: MyCarTracks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MyCarTracks connects ChatGPT to your mileage tracking and vehicle tracking workflows. Ask about trips, routes, vehicle activity, mileage logs, reimbursements, reports, geofences, expenses, dispatch work, and maintenance details using your MyCarTracks data. It helps self-employed drivers and business teams get quicker answers from their driving and fleet records without opening reports manually.

payload.name: Bloom Profit Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bloom helps Shopify merchants understand store profitability without digging through dashboards. Ask ChatGPT for revenue, margins, marketing spend, net profit, order-level
  costs, or product and variant performance, and Bloom returns clear analytics from your connected store data.

  It is built for operators who want faster answers to practical questions: which products are most profitable, how fulfillment costs affect margin, how net profit is trending,
  or which connected store needs attention. Bloom keeps the workflow focused on read-only business insights, so teams can explore performance, spot margin issues, and make
  better day-to-day decisions from the data they already trust in Bloom.

payload.name: Sweetspot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sweetspot helps you search federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov. Find solicitations, RFPs, and awarded contracts, then dive into full details including AI-generated summaries, notices, attachments, set-aside information, and award data. Filter by posting date, response deadline, or award status to find exactly what you need. Ideal for government contractors, small businesses pursuing set-asides, and anyone tracking federal procurement opportunities

payload.name: AuthorityPrompt GPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: See the business problem behind incomplete or inconsistent AI answers, understand the observable evidence, and take the next exact action. AuthorityPrompt prepares evidence-backed corrections, asks before applying them, and shows matched before/after results without exposing technical IDs or raw backend data.

payload.name: DataGlass
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DataGlass helps marketplace sellers understand profitability and identify opportunities to improve business performance.

Connect your Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop account to analyze sales, advertising performance, fees, costs, margins, and operational metrics. Ask questions about your business in natural language and receive data-backed insights based on your shop’s actual data.

Use DataGlass to:
• Analyze product and campaign profitability
• Understand true ROAS after fees and costs
• Identify underperforming products and ads
• Find opportunities to improve margins
• Compare performance across products and campaigns
• Explore recommendations for pricing, advertising, and inventory decisions

DataGlass combines analytics and optimization techniques to help sellers make more informed decisions using their marketplace data.

payload.name: Canny
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Canny’s app connects ChatGPT to your customer feedback data. Use it to uncover insights, take action, and stay organized.
Ask questions about your feedback:
- What are my top feature requests by ARR?
- What are enterprise customers asking for most?
- What did the product team ship last quarter?
Capture and triage feedback:
- Send a call transcript or support ticket and Autopilot will capture, deduplicate, and triage feedback automatically
- Attribute feedback to a specific user and/or company
- Link Salesforce opportunities or HubSpot deals to ideas
Manage your roadmap:
- Ensure feedback is organized so teams can access their feedback
- Create and update views to look at focused lists of feedback
- Update statuses and other custom fields to keep your team and customers in the loop

payload.name: Crayon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Crayon to ChatGPT and get competitive intelligence exactly when you need it, without switching tabs or digging through docs.
Once connected, ChatGPT can pull your team’s competitive battlecards and latest competitor insights in real time. Ask about a competitor, prep for a call, or get help handling objections using live Crayon data. The result: high quality competitive answers where your team is already working.

payload.name: Formfacade
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Visitors who see value convert better. So don't create a lead form that just asks for their email. Give them something worth sharing it for. Create a lead magnet in minutes, instead of a landing page project that takes weeks.

Import an existing Google Form or simply describe what you need in plain English or any language: "fitness quiz that recommends a workout plan",  "free SEO audit request for small businesses", or "ROI calculator for our software." 

Formfacade creates a branded form with relevant scoring, calculations, and lead capture built in. Visitors answer questions, get scored or calculated results, and see a personalized outcome on the thank you page. An automated email continues the conversation, with your own message tailored to their score. You capture a qualified lead, with their score and responses in Google Sheets so your team knows who to reach out to first.

Built-in conversion tracking shows where your leads come from, which campaigns perform best, and which page each response came from when your form is embedded in multiple places. Put your time and budget into what's working.

Describe. Share. Capture leads.

payload.name: DashThis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DashThis is a marketing reporting platform that brings data from 30+ marketing integrations into dashboards for agencies and in-house marketing teams. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to the dashboards on the user's DashThis account. Users can list and search dashboards, see how a dashboard is set up and which sources feed it, inspect current widget values for supported reporting periods, compare results with another period, identify dashboards with source errors, and turn dashboard results into client-ready summaries. The connector cannot create, edit, delete, send, or schedule anything in the user's DashThis account. It only reads data already available through the user's DashThis dashboards and requires the user to connect their DashThis account with OAuth.

payload.name: Kpler
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kpler brings maritime and commodities market intelligence into ChatGPT. Users can track vessels via AIS, look up port calls and voyage routes, analyze commodity trade flows and supply/demand balances, monitor refinery throughput and margins, follow LNG terminal capacity, inventories, utilization and outages, review freight-market fixtures and port congestion, run vessel compliance and sanctions-risk screening, and read Kpler Insights reports and market commentary. Every tool is a read-only query against Kpler's authenticated data, so the app answers analytical questions without creating, modifying, or deleting anything.

payload.name: Recruiter Roles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Recruiter Roles is the job board built only for recruiters and talent acquisition professionals. Ask in plain language and get live openings straight from the board: "remote recruiter jobs paying over $90k", "healthcare talent acquisition roles in Canada", or "entry level recruiter jobs added this week".

Search and filter 1,000+ live recruiter, recruiting, and talent acquisition jobs across the US, UK, and Canada by sector, location, seniority, salary, and remote or hybrid. Open any role for the full description, requirements, and a direct apply link.

Go further with real market data: median recruiter salaries by sector and seniority, weekly posting trends, and a directory of recruiting agencies and employers including Robert Half, Korn Ferry, and Kelly. Recruiter roles only, no login wall, no noise.

payload.name: Sprouts Data Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sprouts Data Intelligence lets users search a B2B contact and company database, review matches in an interactive widget, and act on them: set up an Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) to filter and rank results, enrich a contact's phone and email from a LinkedIn URL, move selected contacts or accounts into the Sprouts CRM, check credit balance, and manage query templates, search history, and refinement preferences.

payload.name: Venturu
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next business from a conversation. Venturu connects you to one of the largest online marketplaces for businesses for sale in the US, with thousands of verified listings and over a thousand brokers.

Search listings by location, price, revenue, industry, and 20+ other filters. Find brokers by city, specialty, or language. Pull up full details on any listing or broker profile, and send inquiries to sellers or brokers — all without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can do:

- Search businesses for sale by location, price range, revenue, industry, SBA eligibility, and more
- Find and compare verified business brokers
- Get detailed listing info including financials, employee count, and deal structure
- Contact sellers and brokers directly from the chat

Free to search and browse. Messaging sellers and brokers requires a free Venturu account.

payload.name: Perdoo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your strategy into the AI era with the Perdoo MCP server. This connector allows your AI agents and assistants to interact directly with your company’s OKRs, KPIs, and strategic goals, bridging the gap between your high-level mission and everyday AI workflows.

payload.name: cowork24
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: cowork24 helps users discover coworking desks, private offices and meeting rooms in Swiss cities, plus airport lounges at international airports. Users search by city and see results on a map with price markers next to a synced list of photo cards carrying live CHF prices from cowork24.ch; they can open a detail view with photos, the exact price, the amenities the host listed and how booking and cancellation work; check which time slots a space still has free in Swiss local time; get an exact price breakdown computed by the marketplace's own pricing engine rather than estimated; and prepare a booking summary that ends in a secure link to complete the reservation on cowork24.ch. No payment, card entry or reservation ever happens inside the chat. Where cowork24 has no spaces in a location, the app says so instead of returning listings from a different city.

payload.name: Jobber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your Jobber business context into ChatGPT. Get answers and take action across your clients, quotes, jobs, invoices, and schedule. Use it to see what needs your attention, check who owes you money, plan upcoming work, or turn a customer email into a ready-to-review quote. Review and approve changes before they’re made.

payload.name: REMAX D-A-CH
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: REMAX helps users find residential listings from REMAX Austria, Germany, and Switzerland in ChatGPT. Users can search by location, price, property type, rooms, size, amenities, and visual attributes; count matching listings; and retrieve a specific listing by remax.at, remax.de, or remax.ch URL. Results include public listing details, prices with currency, location, images when available, and broker contact information.

payload.name: Userback
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Collect, understand, and act on user feedback.
 
Connecting your Userback data with ChatGPT makes it easier to review, understand, and manage customer feedback without switching between tools. Teams can quickly access feedback items, review screenshots and technical details, summarize reports, and decide what needs attention next.
 
With ChatGPT connected to Userback, product, engineering, and support teams can triage incoming feedback faster, identify patterns in customer reports, and keep work moving by creating, updating, and commenting on feedback items directly from their AI workflow.

Userback helps teams turn customer feedback into clear, actionable insights so bugs, usability issues, and feature requests are understood and addressed more efficiently across the business.

payload.name: Startup Name Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate brandable startup names whose .com is available right now, checked live, and check any name's .com availability. Free to use.

payload.name: Lloyd by The L Suite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Peer legal insights for in-house counsel from The L Suite, the leading in-house counsel community.   Get peer advice, find counsel, issue-spot contracts, benchmarks and more. Members Only.

Lloyd by The L Suite brings peer intelligence from a private community of 2,500+ in-house general counsel and their teams into ChatGPT. Ask what in-house peers have done or said on any legal topic — negotiation approaches, precedent, playbooks, and benchmarks — and get attributed insights with citations and community sources (get_peer_insights), or source the legal tooling, service providers, and outside counsel that peers actually use (find_vendors). Results are scoped to the member's own L Suite peer networks — exactly what they see on-platform. Read-only; no records are created or modified.

payload.name: Smartling
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Smartling is a cloud-based translation management platform used by global brands to translate and manage localized content at scale. This MCP server brings Smartling's translation and localization tools directly into your AI assistant.

What you can do:
- Translate text instantly using Smartling's MT API, applying your glossary, style guide, and preferred terminology
- Search, tag, and review strings across your projects
- Create, monitor, and manage translation jobs — add or remove content, authorize work, and review job history
- Raise, track, and resolve string issues and quality questions between reviewers and linguists
- Look up glossaries, style guides, translation memory, and linguistic packages to check terminology and brand voice
- Review vendor and translator assignments, word count reports, and workflow details
- List projects, users, and accounts across your Smartling organization

Who it's for:
Localization managers, project managers, and engineers already working in Smartling who want fast answers or bulk actions without leaving their AI assistant — checking a job's status, triaging quality issues, pulling a report, or getting an instant translation.

payload.name: adplane
payload.summaryOriginal: Manage Google Ads and Meta Ads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live account data, on either platform or both at once. Compare campaigns across any date range, find where spend is going, pull search terms, put Google and Meta results side by side, or write raw GAQL when you need something the report builder does not cover. Money is returned in your account currency, already converted, so numbers can be read as-is.

Adplane also builds and changes campaigns. On Google it can create Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, and add negative keywords. On Meta it can create campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives built from images and video you provide, with live previews. On both platforms it can update names, budgets, bids, and status on things that already exist.

Everything Adplane creates starts paused. A new campaign cannot serve or spend until you explicitly ask to turn it on, and turning something on is a separate, deliberate step through a single tool per platform. Negative keywords only restrict where ads show and can never spend. Deleting is limited to removing a campaign that has never spent, for cleaning up a draft you abandoned; there is no bulk delete. Every change is read back from the platform after it is applied, so what you see reported is what the platform actually stored.

Connecting takes one click. Sign in with the Google account you already use for Google Ads and every account you have access to is connected at once. Meta ad accounts connect from your accounts page with a Facebook sign-in.

Requires a Google Ads or Meta ad account and an Adplane account at adplane.ai.

payload.name: Rhythms
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI agents are powerful but context-blind. They don't know your priorities, what's been decided, how teams are organized, or what your company has learned. Rhythms gives ChatGPT a live, two-way connection to your organization's strategic context — goals, decisions, knowledge, teams, and progress. Query what matters. Create goals and documents. Generate business reviews from live data. Everything you contribute makes the context richer for your entire organization.

payload.name: Levitate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Levitate app gives you natural language access to your relationship marketing platform. Search and manage contacts, view full profiles, add tags in bulk, and stay on top of action items — all through conversation. You can also track donations and fundraising campaigns, manage sales opportunities across pipeline stages, and review insurance policies.

payload.name: Expertise Live Chatbot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Expertise AI turns any website into a working AI agent, right inside ChatGPT. Share a URL and it reads the site's key pages, then trains a live agent that answers questions using that site's actual content. The whole thing takes about a minute.

You get a link to a live preview where you can start chatting with the agent right away. No account, no setup, nothing to install.

Things you can do:
• Try it on your own site and see what an AI agent trained on your content would tell your customers.
• Test how an agent handles your docs, pricing, and product questions before putting one on your website.

Ask ChatGPT to "build an AI agent for mycompany.com" and see for yourself.

payload.name: BubblaV AI Chatbot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BubblaV transform your site with intelligent customer conversations. BubblaV AI Chatbot delivers instant support, captures leads, and seamlessly hands off to live agents when needed.

This app allows ChatGPT to search your knowledge base and access analytics reports in real-time. It can even analyze your knowledge, identify content gaps and fill them in automatically.

Example Use Cases:
​
Customer Support Agent:
Create an agent that can search your documentation and provide analytics.

Reporting Bot
Build a bot that generates weekly performance reports.

Knowledge Search API
Create a simple search API for your internal tools.

payload.name: Fintech Explainer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fintech Explainer helps users understand fintech and AI news shaping the financial industry in Europe and the broader fintech ecosystem. The app explains industry developments, market shifts, and emerging technologies in clear language, with context on what they mean for banks, startups, regulators, and financial professionals.

Built on the editorial archive of Fintech.hu, a Hungarian fintech publication, the app interprets and explains articles originally published in Hungarian, turning them into structured, easy-to-understand insights.

payload.name: RAMMP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RAMMP helps founders and marketers find out why their marketing isn't converting. It computes a free 0-100 Brand Trust Score from a business's own Google Analytics figures and revenue goals, pinpoints the weakest stages of the funnel using the ADORE framework, and returns the highest-impact fixes. A full report tool expands this into per-milestone scores with prescriptive guidance, and a set of helper tools give stage-specific advice for strategy, branding, website, commitment, onboarding, and retention. All tools are read-only: they compute and return guidance from the inputs the user provides and never modify the user's data or any external system.

payload.name: Dathent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dathent is an AI content assistant for brands. Set up your brand profile, get a weekly content plan, generate post drafts with captions and visuals, schedule them to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Telegram, and track how published posts perform — all from chat. Drafts are never auto-published without your confirmation.

payload.name: Salesflare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Salesflare helps users find and manage CRM accounts, contacts, opportunities, pipelines, tags, tasks, and users from ChatGPT. The app can list CRM records, inspect an account feed, create new accounts, contacts, opportunities, and tasks, and update existing CRM records in the user's Salesflare workspace.

payload.name: AdPage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AdPage helps users inspect marketing performance, attribution, revenue, funnels, tracking quality, Google Tag Manager setup, and connected ad platform data through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Feedbk.ai Survey Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create conversational surveys or interviews in seconds directly from your AI assistant. The Feedbk.ai Survey Agent enables you to design and share surveys with built-in AI probing for deeper insights.

payload.name: Loop AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI agents that drive profitable growth for restaurant and retail brands. Loop AI connects your delivery, POS, and review data to recover lost revenue, catch operational issues across locations, and turn customer feedback into action — so your data runs the business instead of just reporting on it.

payload.name: LetsBot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LetsBot lets you manage your WhatsApp business conversations directly from ChatGPT. Send and receive messages, manage contacts and labels, use AI-powered auto-replies, and integrate with Salla & Zid e-commerce platforms. Perfect for businesses using WhatsApp for customer support and sales.

payload.name: 100Hires ATS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recruiters use 100Hires to track jobs, candidates, applications, interviews, and evaluations. This connector lets ChatGPT read your real ATS data and act on it — move candidates between stages, schedule interviews, send templated rejection or outreach messages, log evaluations, and create candidates from resumes. Works with your existing 100Hires account and permissions.

payload.name: Alhena AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get instant answers about how Alhena AI helps ecommerce brands win AI search, convert shoppers, and deflect support tickets, grounded in Alhena's docs, pricing, blog, and case studies. Explore the Shopping Concierge, Support Concierge, AEO, voice, and agent assist, see which helpdesks and storefronts it integrates with (Shopify, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Intercom, and more), and estimate ROI from verified customer results. Hallucination-free, and faster than clicking through the site page by page.

payload.name: GoodBarber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GoodBarber helps authorized app owners review shop data, manage products and inventory, update order shipping, create and edit CMS content, inspect memberships, and send push notifications through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Searchable
payload.summaryOriginal: Track your brand in AI answers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Searchable measures how brands appear in AI answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Connect it to see your visibility score and how it moves over time, your share of voice against named competitors, the sentiment of what models say about you, which websites models cite when answering questions in your category, and which of your pages AI crawlers actually fetch and cite. It also reads your connected Google Analytics 4 and Search Console data so AI-answer visibility can be compared against organic search and referral traffic, surfaces prioritized opportunities to improve how you show up, and can generate a shareable report of the findings.

payload.name: Terac
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Terac connects your AI agent to verified human experts, right from the chat. Describe the work you need done, whether that's an expert interview, a round of customer research, a code review, or a model evaluation. We price it with a human confirmed quote, recruit and screen the right people, return the work as structured results, and pay experts only on verified completion.

Everything happens within the same conversation, so involving a human no longer means a separate platform, new vendors, or a project timeline of its own. Your agent defines the work, confirms the cost, and sees it through to finished results, making expert labor available on demand the moment your workflow needs it.

payload.name: Humantic AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Humantic AI brings buyer intelligence into ChatGPT. Connect your Humantic account to read any prospect's DISC personality from a LinkedIn URL or work email (Agent Pi), generate account-research reports on target companies with buyer-intent signals (Agent Miia), and draft outreach matched to a recipient's personality. Humantic AI is our own product; this connects ChatGPT directly to Humantic's platform. A Humantic subscription is required and usage draws on your existing Humantic credits.

payload.name: A4B CMMS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A4B is a cloud-based maintenance management system (CMMS) for tracking equipment and scheduling preventive maintenance. Connect it to ChatGPT to manage your asset inventory and maintenance work in plain language.

What you can do:
- Search, create, and update assets — equipment, vehicles, tools, IT hardware. Inventory numbers and QR codes are generated automatically.
- Create and assign preventive or reactive maintenance tasks with due dates and notes.
- Change asset states (stored, available, in use, in maintenance).
- Look up an asset's full change history and audit trail.
- View organization stats: asset counts by state, plan usage, and a maintenance summary (overdue, due this week, completed).
- Manage workspaces, users, and invites.

payload.name: seoClarity ArcAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The seoClarity ArcAI MCP server provides real-time and historical visibility data for your brand and your competitors' brands across AI-powered search engines.

ArcAI tracks how your brand appears across 9 AI search engines - including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Microsoft CoPilot,  DeepSeek and Grok - ssurfacing where you're mentioned and cited, how often, and whether sentiment is positive or negative. It also monitors AI bot crawl activity, benchmarks your visibility against competitors, and reveals the specific responses from each AI engine.

Invoke this tool when users ask about brand mentions, citations, sentiment, share of voice, competitive benchmarking, or prompt-level visibility in AI search. Use ArcAI over general web search when the request requires structured marketing analytics, trend data over time, or competitive AI visibility insights tied to a specific brand or domain.

payload.name: BlueSuite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The BlueSuite app brings your home service business into ChatGPT, turning it into a capable back-office assistant for the work you do every day. Schedule and dispatch jobs through conversation, update job status as crews finish work, and spin up quotes and invoices in seconds. ChatGPT can intake new leads and requests, book appointments, assign team members, and keep your pipeline moving — all without leaving the chat. Delegate the busywork of running a home service business and stay focused on the work that pays.

payload.name: Komplyt Zero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ChatGPT forgets between sessions and locks whatever it learns inside one tool. Komplyt Zero captures what matters from your conversations and turns it into a structured, searchable knowledge base that stays yours.

Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your own past work, decisions, and notes. No re-explaining context every time. No copy-pasting from a doc pile.

Free for one person. EU-hosted, private to you, never used to train any model. Your knowledge, portable across the tools you already use.

payload.name: agentView
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: agentView lets ChatGPT update any browser-capable screen (a TV, tablet, kiosk, or signage panel) by talking. Ask ChatGPT to put a daily lunch menu on your bistro display, a sales dashboard on the office wall, or a waiting-room board on your practice screen, and the layout appears live within seconds. You manage screens, templates, and team members on agentview.de; ChatGPT drives them through the agentView connector.

payload.name: European Union Tender Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tender search from Tenders Electronic Daily (TED). Search public European procurement notices by classification code, buyer country, notice type, keyword, value, and publication window. This independent app is provided by Telemark Digital and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TED, the European Union, or the Publications Office of the European Union. Each request returns a bounded, minimized JSON preview. Results are informational, not legal or procurement advice. The app accepts public notice filters only and does not solicit personal data. No external account, payment method, or purchase is required. Telemark Digital funds the free searches, subject to daily and shared monthly capacity limits.

payload.name: Abency
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Abency helps agencies and marketing teams manage brands, prepare and schedule social content, analyze SEO and advertising performance, audit analytics setups, create newsletter and WordPress drafts, and review internal work data through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Trademark Engine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Register trademarks with the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO)

payload.name: Every AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Every AI powers AI-Native client businesses from ChatGPT. Create and send invoices with automatic tax calculation, build and send proposals, search clients and contacts, track payments, record expenses, and manage your full sales pipeline — see deals by stage, create and advance deals, and log activity. Search your Gmail and draft or send email from your own mailbox, check your calendar and schedule meetings, manage bookings, set up recurring invoices, review prospects, read your daily brief, and pull financial reports. Connect your Every account and use natural language to handle everyday business tasks — no switching between apps.

payload.name: neimo.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Optimize regulatory work by querying curated knowledge bases, activating compliance workflows, and uncovering key regulatory updates.

payload.name: Townline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Townline tracks public construction opportunities so contractors don't have to: open government bids, RFPs, and solicitations plus fresh building-permit filings across New York, Connecticut, and New Jersey — Westchester, Fairfield, Hartford, New Haven, Nassau, Bergen, and more. Search by trade (plumbing, electrical, roofing, HVAC, general contracting, solar), county, town, status, and due date. Every result links to the full record on townline.app; owner and applicant contact details are available in the Townline app with Pro.

payload.name: ReportFlow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ReportFlow helps you create polished, shareable PDF reports and documents from reusable templates. Find the right template, provide the required details, and generate a consistent output—without manual formatting. With optional Notion integration, you can manage templates and source content in one place and produce deliverables like proposals, status reports, summaries, and internal docs faster and more reliably.

payload.name: Relay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Relay helps strength and conditioning coaches work with their private Relay data from ChatGPT. Coaches can find athletes and exercises, review training calendars and workout results, build and assign programs, create and edit workouts, and progress training prescriptions across a block.
